description: Issue and cancel track warrants and track-and-time authorities with conflict checking; keep the train sheet; issue slow orders and bulletins; radio contact with every train and work group
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Movement authority protects trains and roadway workers (safety). Paper dispatch can carry one operating day (one shift); after that interchange and switching stop. Active authorities must be known to the minute, so the paper log is the fallback record
manual_workaround: Paper track warrant forms read and repeated by radio, with a written dispatcher log; printed timetable, track chart, and current slow orders at the desk; radio roll call of every movement before the first paper authority
dependent_third_parties: Operations SaaS vendor; radio service vendor; internet provider; MSP
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner and General Manager; Roadmaster (relief dispatcher); dispatch desk in the Junction office

description: Daily interchange turn to the Class I yard (2.5 miles on the Class I main line under its dispatcher); local switching of 6 customers; crew tablets show switch lists, train lists, and bulletins
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $4,400 of revenue per operating day; customers' plants need cars within a day; the Class I's interchange cut-off; car hire accrues on cars held
manual_workaround: Print switch lists from the last car inventory export; conductor's handwritten list; call the Class I yard office for the inbound list; run the turn on radio and paper
dependent_third_parties: Operations SaaS vendor; connecting Class I; customers
dependent_people_or_facilities: Locomotive Engineer; Conductor; Mechanic (relief conductor); 2 road locomotives

business_process: Car management, waybills, and interchange EDI
description: Car inventory and location; waybills; interchange reporting and EDI with the Class I; demurrage records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The Class I needs waybill data before it accepts cars; demurrage and car hire records drive billing
manual_workaround: Enter waybills in the Class I's customer web portal; phone and email the Class I's car management office; rebuild the car list from the daily switch lists
dependent_third_parties: Operations SaaS vendor; connecting Class I

description: Accept propane tank cars after a ground-level inspection; carry shipping papers and emergency response information; apply the hazmat security plan measures; hazmat car list
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: No hazmat car moves without shipping papers and emergency response information; a release of propane threatens crews and the public; the distributor needs supply within a few days
manual_workaround: Hold propane cars on the customer's track until papers are available; use the shipper's paper bill of lading and the printed emergency response guide in each locomotive
dependent_systems: SYS-01 (hazmat car list and shipping documents); SYS-02 (security plan); SYS-03 (crew tablets)
dependent_third_parties: Propane distributor; Operations SaaS vendor; connecting Class I
dependent_people_or_facilities: Conductor; Locomotive Engineer; Owner and General Manager

description: Weekly main track inspections by the designated inspector (49 CFR 213.233); slow orders; inspection and repair records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Inspections are done on the track, not in a system; slow orders must reach the dispatcher and crews the same day; inspection records must be kept
manual_workaround: Paper inspection forms; slow orders by radio and on paper bulletins; enter records once restored

description: Daily locomotive inspections; car inspections; repairs; telematics alarms for fuel and engine faults
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Inspections are paper-based; telematics only adds convenience
manual_workaround: Paper inspection forms; manual fuel checks

description: TSA Security Coordinator reachable 24/7; reports of significant security concerns to TSA within 24 hours; FRA immediate telephone reports; hazmat incident notice to the National Response Center; SSI protection
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: TSA 24-hour reporting clock (49 CFR 1570.203) and 24/7 accessibility (1570.201(f)(2)); FRA and hazmat notices are immediate or within hours
manual_workaround: Printed contact card and report forms in the incident binder at the desk and in the General Manager's and Roadmaster's vehicles; personal cell phones
dependent_systems: Cell phones; SYS-02 (contact lists and forms)
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner and General Manager; Roadmaster (alternate Security Coordinator)
